classificationMeaning: SUPPORTED means retained source relationships support the stated intended factor/formula correspondence, not competent applicability, precision or lifecycle approval. PARTIAL marks a concrete mapping/approximation decision still needed. All values remain subject to binary64 representation and operation error.

facts.supportedCorrespondence: International inch .0254 m; foot=12 inches; yard=3 feet; mile=5280 feet. All declared decimal length factors match these exact constructions and SI prefixes.
facts.remainingDecision: Product aliases in/ft/yd/mi correspond to international UCUM codes [in_i]/[ft_i]/[yd_i]/[mi_i], not survey variants.

facts.supportedCorrespondence: Square international foot/yard/mile and SI area factors match; hectare derives from 100 ar, ar=100 m2. Acre4046.8564224 equals 4840 international yards squared.
facts.remainingDecision: UCUM [acr_us] uses survey rod/foot and differs; [acr_br] uses British historical yard. Retained bytes do not directly name the international acre used by this code; require explicit mapping/source applicability, never substitute another acre.

facts.supportedCorrespondence: Liter=dm3; cubic inch/foot derive from international inch/foot. UCUM [gal_us]=231[in_i]3 and [qt_us]=[gal_us]/4 exactly match declared US liquid gallon/quart decimals.
facts.remainingDecision: Product gal_us/qt_us are explicit aliases, not imperial gallon/quart.

facts.supportedCorrespondence: Native source defines Celsius xK-273.15 and inverse xC+273.15; Fahrenheit=9/5*xK-459.67 and inverse=5/9*(xF+459.67). Existing pair formulas are algebraically consistent.
facts.remainingDecision: Binary64 offset/multiplier error and cancellation need separate numerical review; no physical-domain applicability inferred.

facts.supportedCorrespondence: International mile/foot, hour=3600s and nautical mile1852m support mph=.44704, ft/s=.3048, km/h=1000/3600 and knot1852/3600 m/s.
facts.remainingDecision: Division expressions are binary64 approximations; exact source relationships do not establish output precision.

facts.supportedCorrespondence: Pa SI construction, bar=100000Pa and atm=101325Pa directly supported. UCUM [psi]=[lbf_av]/[in_i]2.
facts.remainingDecision: Legacy psi6894.757293168 truncates source-derived6894.7572931683613367... and is not its nearest binary64. Approximation requires an explicit accepted error/domain decision.

facts.supportedCorrespondence: J=N.m; W=J/s; hour=3600s supports Wh/kWh. UCUM cal_th=4.184J and cal=cal_th match existing thermochemical cal/kcal.
facts.remainingDecision: Do not infer alternate calorie variants or nutritional applicability.

facts.supportedCorrespondence: UCUM [HP]=550[ft_i].[lbf_av]/s derives exact745.69987158227022W. Existing literal745.6998715822702 yields the nearest binary64 to that exact value.
facts.remainingDecision: Decimal spelling differs by2e-14W, but there is no additional stored-number truncation beyond nearest binary64 representation. hp_mech->[HP] mapping remains explicit.

facts.supportedCorrespondence: UCUM deg=2[pi].rad/360; gon=.9deg; circ=2[pi].rad. These support degree, grad=gon, and turn=circ formulas.
facts.remainingDecision: Math.PI is an approximation; UCUM itself stores a finite long decimal [pi]. Do not claim exact real-pi outputs or silently treat product rad/deg/grad/turn as UCUM literal codes.

facts.supportedCorrespondence: UCUM By=8bit; decimal k/M/G/T prefixes=1000/1e6/1e9/1e12 and binary Ki/Mi/Gi=1024/1048576/1073741824 match byte-factor ratios exactly.
facts.remainingDecision: Product B/KB/MB/GB/TB mean By/kBy/MBy/GBy/TBy. Case-sensitive KB is a product alias, not a UCUM unit spelling; no bit mode or reinterpretation.

facts.supportedCorrespondence: kg/m3, g/cm3 and kg/l factors follow SI and liter. UCUM pound and international foot derive lb/ft3=16.018463373960139579...kg/m3.
facts.remainingDecision: Legacy16.01846337396 is not nearest binary64 to that source-derived value. Approximation approval remains pending.

facts.supportedCorrespondence: N=kg.m/s2; dyn=g.cm/s2=1e-5N; [lbf_av]=[lb_av].[g] with pound=.45359237kg and standard gravity9.80665m/s2 gives exact4.4482216152605N.
facts.remainingDecision: Standard conventional force only; no location-dependent mass/weight model or output precision approval.

facts.supportedCorrespondence: Source-defined lbf times international foot gives exact1.3558179483314004N.m; lbf times international inch gives exact.1129848290276167N.m.
facts.remainingDecision: Legacy constant1.3558179483314 and its /12 inch expression are not nearest binary64 to these source values. Existing twelve-inch geometry does not erase absolute factor approximation.
